canvas-void.$description: Canvas Void — Page background, hero canvas, deepest surface layer

off-white.$description: Off-White — Primary text, headlines, icon strokes, card backgrounds inside dark frames, borders on cards — warm cream gives the type a lit-from-within quality against pure black

surface-charcoal.$description: Surface Charcoal — Elevated surface for inputs, nav elements, card interiors — sits one step above the canvas to create depth without lightness

muted-smoke.$description: Muted Smoke — Secondary text, inactive link borders, subdued metadata

faint-fog.$description: Faint Fog — Tertiary borders, placeholder text, low-emphasis dividers

chartreuse-pulse.$description: Chartreuse Pulse — Filled CTA buttons, active nav indicators, accent borders, highlight strokes — the single chromatic spark against the monochrome void; near-black text on this fill creates an inverted button effect

favorit-extended.$description: Favorit extended — detected in extracted data but not described by AI

favorit.$description: Primary typeface across all contexts — body copy, nav, labels, cards, and headings
